post.title: Inflation counts a rent homeowners never pay
post.ig:
Inflation counts a rent that homeowners never actually pay.

About a quarter of the CPI is "owners' equivalent rent": what homes would rent for.
Each month the BLS checks about 80,000 prices in 75 US cities.
The math: (new index - old index) / old index. August 2025 to August 2026: (334.980 - 323.976) / 323.976 = 3.4%.
Annual average CPI inflation: 8.0% in 2022, 2.6% in 2025.

Sources: BLS CPI release (August 2026), BLS CPI overview and rent/OER factsheet.
